desc: Find and stabilize the Astral Assemblage(s) to activate the Celestial Axis at the center of the Sacred City…

customize.text:
<color=#ebe4d8>Ancient Sacred Mountain</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>Find and stabilize the Astral Assemblage(s) to activate the Celestial Axis at the center of the Sacred City...</color>
Quest Objective: Break the seal over the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Chosen of Dragons... This place was once sealed.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Break the seal outside the Astral Assemblage to unleash the power contained in this place.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh, that thing's locked way up high... Paimon doesn't know if we have enough strength...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Raaawr! Roawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> You think we should charge up there? But there isn't even a path!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! So, it turns out these stone steps can be pushed...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Unless... Do you think we use these steps to form a path?
(When the player does not push the platform the right way.)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm... How about we try pushing this stone platform to make a path?
(Optional Dialogue: The Player interacts with the lever inside the ruin)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Something's not right! The floor's moving backward... We have to hurry up!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rrah... Rawr!
(Optional Dialogue: The Player interacts with the other lever inside the ruin)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Phew. It's over at last...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Honestly, even just watching that was exhausting...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rroo...
<color=#ffffff>External interference removed. Re-establishing corrupted signal flow.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Astral Assemblage resuming normal operations.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Interact with: "Activate Astral Assemblage"</color>
<color=#ffffff>The scene materializes before you like some nostalgic memory.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Operations stream along countless convolutions, flowing spectrum paths that shift across layered platforms.</color>
<color=#ffffff>The accumulated Phlogiston coalesces under immense pressure into a floating, controllable ball of heat.</color>
<color=#ffffff>"We've done it!" Your brethren cheer all around you.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Yet the one who masterminded this feat, in no way inferior to star-forging, stands outside the experimental site, as though wholly unrelated to this momentous deed.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Congratulations are in order. Creating something equivalent to a celestial body in miniature... An "Astral Assemblage," is it? Truly, a grand achievement, comparable with lunar reconstruction.
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> "That one" would surely have tucked their wings in and nodded congratulations to you — were they still with us.
<color=#ffffff>"...If you had been willing to help, it might have been completed long ago."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> I have no interest in it.
<color=#ffffff>"...But you should help me, Kukulkan. We have driven the All-Plunderer's herald into the deepest of mountain valleys, yet once its master awakens..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"It will surely bring another catastrophe upon our people."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Ah, how very noble of you, creating this thing to protect your pitiable brethren...
<color=#ffffff>"'Our' pitiable brethren."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"This is only the beginning, and my days are numbered. I must forge a new path for the Dragonborn before the pitch-black shadow smothers us all."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Or, perhaps, you should let them find their own way... Forgive my forthrightness, but the path you plan to create may be too narrow for our kind.
<color=#ffffff>"The narrow way must be walked. When your time runs short... When waiting becomes a luxury."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Enough waiting, I say. A time will come, Kukulkan, when your days go down like the sun behind the hills, and you will understand. Then, you shall make the same decision as I have..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> ...My king, my elder brother, O lord who gave me life on the day you yourself were born... On this alone I cannot concede to you.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh. That... Did we just see something that happened when this fireball was made?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> You saw that too, Paimon?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah, Paimon saw it super clearly this time as well... The ones surrounding this cake platform had to be the dragons who used to live here...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But who were the two people who were speaking, then? Weird...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Graawrr...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Anyway, the seal on the Astral Assemblage here should be broken now, right?
